title: The second of January
logline: The alley the morning after the year turned: a bottle on the tavern's step, the garage's window, the pup at the door waiting to go out. The page's first walk of 2022, before it starts.

panels.composition: A gravel alley in gray morning light with an empty bottle on a tavern's back step, a small three-legged dog sitting at a garage door waiting, the door's window lit.
